name: PACDI
description: PACDI (Precision Adaptive Climate and Dosage Intelligence) is an IoT greenhouse management system with ML-driven climate optimization. Deploys stress detection models on ESP32-S3 edge nodes to monitor CO2, humidity, light, and soil conductivity. Integrates LLM-powered agronomic recommendations via MQTT-triggered advisory pipelines. Patent filed. Developed for deployment in controlled agricultural environments with sub-5% deviation from optimal growth parameter ranges.
reported_outcome: Patent Filed. Reduced water and energy overuse using ESP32-S3 based optimization.
